description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidGotoDeclarationHandler, which implements the GotoDeclarationHandler interface to provide navigation targets for Android resource references within the IDE. It handles resolving references to Android resources and manifest elements for IDE features like 'Go to Declaration'.

classes.name: AndroidGotoDeclarationHandler
classes.description: Implements IDE navigation to Android resource and manifest declaration targets based on the source element.

methods.name: getGotoDeclarationTargets
methods.description: Resolves the target elements for 'Go to Declaration' based on the source element, resource references, and manifest elements.

methods.name: collectManifestElements
methods.description: Collects manifest permission or permission group elements matching the specified name.

methods.name: getActionText
methods.description: Returns null, indicating default action text.
